title: Gold tier discount on quotes
body:
Gold customers get 10% off shipping quotes.

Add `discounted_quote(weight_kg, zone, tier)` to `parcelo/rates.py`. It returns the regular quote for that weight and zone, with 10% off for the "gold" tier and no discount for "standard". Round the result the same way the existing discount logic does; `apply_discount` in `parcelo/legacy/billing.py` has the same percentage math.

An unknown zone or an unknown tier must fail.
